CODE
 import plotly.graph_objects as go
import pandas as pd

stages = [
    "Application Submitted",
    "Credit Evaluation",
    "Risk Assessment",
    "Final Approval",
    "Funds Released",
    "Investment Completed"
]

countries = ["Bulgaria", "Lithuania", "Turkey", "Romania", "Croatia", "Hungary"]

data = {
    "Application Submitted": [1000, 980, 1200, 950, 900, 920],
    "Credit Evaluation": [850, 880, 950, 870, 820, 860],
    "Risk Assessment": [780, 820, 900, 810, 770, 800],
    "Final Approval": [720, 760, 800, 740, 700, 730],
    "Funds Released": [650, 700, 680, 660, 610, 640],
    "Investment Completed": [580, 630, 550, 590, 540, 570]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data, index=countries)

fig = go.Figure()

colors = ["#4e79a7", "#f28e2b", "#e15759", "#76b7b2", "#59a14f", "#edc948"]

for i, stage in enumerate(stages):
    if stage != "Risk Assessment":
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=df.index,
            y=df[stage],
            name=stage,
            marker_color=colors[i]
        ))

fig.update_layout(
    title="Firm Progress by Stage in Bank Loan Investment Process (2006)",
    xaxis_title="Country",
    yaxis_title="Number of Firms",
    barmode="group",
    bargap=0.15,
    bargroupgap=0.1,
    legend_title="Stage of Process",
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    width=900,
    height=600
)

fig.write_image("output.png")

'''    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
        x=df.index,
        y=df[stage],
        name=stage,
        marker_color=colors[i]
    ))''')
p.write_text(s)
exec(compile(s, "chart.py", "exec"))
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
assert len(fig.data) == 6
for trace, stage, color in zip(fig.data, stages, colors):
    assert trace.type == "bar"
    assert trace.name == stage
    assert list(trace.x) == table["Country"].tolist()
    assert list(trace.y) == table[stage].tolist()
    assert trace.marker.color == color
print("Verified six bar traces, country order, all values, and colors.")
print("Title:", fig.layout.title.text)
print("Bar mode:", fig.layout.barmode)
print("Y-axis:", fig.full_figure_for_development(warn=False).layout.yaxis.range)
